name: Torikai Nina
source: A girl who lives in apartment 202, directly above Naoto. She is half Japanese and half Russian. Nina is cheerful, energetic, and trusting. She used to live in Russia, but she moved to Japan with her mother and father. She enjoys cultivating the small vegetable garden behind the apartment building.
